label: Visual art medium
description: Art materials and image-making processes, from painting and printmaking to animation, sculpture, and fiber art.
notes: Broad media and making processes belong here, with article-led noun phrases that follow “made as.” art.rendering owns specific 3D, game, and digital rendering looks; art.craft expands named decorative techniques and traditions. art.style owns movements and illustration styles, while camera.film_look owns photographic film treatments. Craft and sculpture entries depict the subject as a made object, and animation entries describe a single frame.
